methods.description: Produce, complete or check equivalent fractions by multiplying or dividing both numerator and denominator by the same positive whole number, keeping the same amount.
Use the same whole divided into equal parts to count or regroup the selected fraction and record its equivalent notation.
Use a familiar grouped fraction to bridge two requested subdivisions: group equal parts first, then split each part equally.
